Subject: Region anchoring validation & erase-proof checklist

Hi Naomi,

We're preparing for a FinLedger internal compliance review (deadline: 2027-01-05) and need to confirm the following for our Dedicated deployment:

- How region pinning is enforced for tenant data (physical hosts, AZs, and cloud region).
- Evidence artifacts you can provide to prove no cross-region replication occurs (sample logs or manifests).
- Deletion/erase playbook and expected timeline for a tenant purge (including snapshot handling).
- Retention windows for ephemeral backups and any off-cluster snapshots.

Can you share your recommended checklist and an example artifact we can include in our audit pack? Attaching our internal questionnaire (questions_doc.pdf).

Date: 2026-12-15T11:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Region anchoring validation & erase-proof checklist

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary and next steps below.

Short answers:
- Region pinning: tenant scheduling is pinned at creation time to a single cloud region (us-east-1 for your Dedicated cluster). We do not place replicas in other regions for Dedicated customers by default.
- Evidence: we can produce a time-stamped manifest (sample CSV) showing tenant-to-host assignments, and an audit log slice showing replication flags disabled.
- Erasure: standard tenant-purge runs include KV cache wipe, object-store tombstone + overwrite, and metadata scrub. Expected completion: typical completion within 48 hours, with forensic artifacts generated within 5 business days.
- Retention: ephemeral backup retention = 7 days by policy for Dedicated; longer-term snapshots are disabled unless explicitly configured.

I've attached our "geofence-checklist-template.xlsx" and the "tenant-scrub-playbook.pdf" to help you map to your questionnaire. Looping in Ben (sales) for SLA/attestation cadence and Laura and Karthik for evidence delivery.

Next actions:
1) Karthik to provide the sample manifest and a brief technical note on the purge steps.
2) We will upload one sample artifact to a shared Drive folder and provide access to your team.
3) Naomi to confirm formal attestation ETA once artifacts are posted.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments: geofence-checklist-template.xlsx, tenant-scrub-playbook.pdf

Hi all,

Attached is a sample artifact: "sample-erase-manifest.csv" (stub). Representative contents (redacted):

tenant_id,host_id,region,pinned_at,replication_disabled,latest_snapshot_id
finledger-prod,host-az1-34,us-east-1,2026-06-12T08:22:33Z,true,snap-000f1234

Notes:
- Dedicated clusters: scheduling layer tags tenants with a "region_pin" attribute — this is enforced by the scheduler and the storage operator; replication to other regions is blocked by policy at the orchestration level.
- Snapshots: automated cross-region snapshot/export is disabled by default. Any snapshot export requires an explicit account-level opt-in; opt-ins are logged and require two approvers.
- Purge workflow: 1) disable tenant access, 2) drain in-flight KV cache, 3) destroy object-store keys (overwrite tombstone + object rewrite), 4) delete metadata and issue eviction signal to scheduler, 5) mark manifest "erased" and emit audit event. Each step is logged and the audit events are collected into a CSV we can share for the audit.
- Timings: large tenants with many snapshots may take up to 72 hours end-to-end; typical cases complete in 24–48 hours. We keep operation-trace logs for 90 days.

I will upload the sample artifact to the Drive link Naomi supplies and include a short README describing the log fields.

-Karthik
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample-erase-manifest.csv (stub)
